issues.summary: President Yoweri Museveni’s ceaseless and patient gospel on Patriotism is beginning to show results. Patriotism is the first of the four principles of the National Resistance Movement (NRM), the others being Pan-Africanism, Socioeconomic transformation and Democracy, of which the President, again, is the chief advocate in Uganda, Africa and the world at large.
